gateDecision: CLOSED. Training and retention are VERIFIED. Zero data retention is NOT_SUPPORTED for qwen3.7-flash and needs a recorded user decision (WAIVER_NOT_VERIFIED). Logging through OpenRouter is UNKNOWN. No live request is authorised by this file.

facts.subject: training on request data
facts.statement: Without separate consent, Alibaba Cloud will not use business data (inputs, outputs, files) to train any foundation model.

facts.subject: retention period of request data
facts.statement: Prompts and responses are retained for no longer than 30 days by default; longer where required by applicable law or for service security.

facts.subject: zero data retention for qwen3.7-flash
facts.statement: The ZDR-supported model list includes qwen-plus from qwen3.7-plus; the flash entry begins at qwen3.8-flash. qwen3.7-flash is not listed.

facts.subject: ZDR decision by the user
facts.statement: No written decision recorded. A request-level approval does not count. The gate stays closed until a decision names the risk.

facts.subject: logging of request content through the OpenRouter endpoint
facts.statement: NOT_ON_PAGE: the OpenRouter provider page does not state Alibaba's storage through OpenRouter. The statement that Alibaba stores prompts on OpenRouter has not been verified here.

facts.subject: data_collection request preference
facts.statement: Values allow (default) and deny. The envelope does not set it; deny would restrict providers and is not decided.

facts.subject: zdr request preference
facts.statement: A boolean; when true the request is routed only to endpoints with a Zero Data Retention policy. Not set by the envelope.
